== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Thunder Fairy is the colloquial title for [[Yushi]], a [[Herald]] who follows a lightning [[Path]]. She serves as a close companion and right hand to [[Reigan Shen]]. In combat, she utilizes Storm madra{{!}}storm madra and possesses a delicate [[sword]] that crackles with energy, alongside wings composed of lightning. Despite the melodic quality of her laughter, she is a formidable fighter who has engaged in intense battles against opponents like [[Yerin]]. Although the name is associated with children's rhymes, [[Yushi]] herself harbors a dislike for the moniker. Her power is significant enough that her [[scales]] are noted as a potential source of [[lightning madra]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Thunder Fairy possesses a voice that sounds like rushing [[wind]] and snapping lightning. This entity is also known as [[Yushi]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This [[Remnant]] serves as a source of [[lightning madra]] [[scales]]. During a confrontation, [[Yerin]] was able to devour power from the Thunder Fairy.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Thunder Fairy, who is known as [[Yushi]], is a [[Remnant]] whose voice carries the sound of rushing [[wind]] and snapping lightning. Following a confrontation with [[Yerin]], the entity's [[spirit]] was left in a weakened state. During this time, [[Mercy]] targeted the Thunder Fairy with arrows. Ultimately, [[Yerin]] devoured power directly from the Thunder Fairy.}}
